title: PublicPreKeyBundle
description: Public prekey bundle uploaded to the server during key provisioning and fetched by clients to establish E2EE sessions.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this bundle.

registrationId.description: The Signal Protocol local registration ID (1..16380).

identityKey.description: Base64-encoded 33-byte Curve25519 identity public key (with 0x05 prefix).

signedPreKey.description: The medium-term signed prekey and its cryptographic signature.

keyId.description: Unique positive integer identifier for the signed prekey.

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded 33-byte Curve25519 signed prekey public key.

signature.description: Base64-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the signed prekey public key.

oneTimePreKeys.description: List of available one-time prekeys. May be empty if exhausted.

keyId.description: Unique positive integer identifier for the one-time prekey.

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded 33-byte Curve25519 one-time prekey public key.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this bundle was constructed.
